web.providers.web-search-enable.label: Search the web
web.providers.web-search-enable.help: Off stops every web search, in chat and in /web.

web.providers.provider-order.label: Order services are tried
web.providers.provider-order.help: Used when an ability has no order of its own.

options.model-native: Your AI model's own web search

web.providers.provider-status.label: Service status
web.providers.provider-status.help: Connected, needs a key, or failed recently. Read only.

options.model-native: Your AI model's own web search

web.providers.health-disclosure.label: Show error details
web.providers.health-disclosure.help: Adds each service's last failure message to the list.

web.providers.duckduckgo-enable.label: DuckDuckGo (free backup)
web.providers.duckduckgo-enable.help: Basic, free search used when other services can't answer.

web.providers.firecrawl-enable.label: Firecrawl
web.providers.firecrawl-enable.help: Reads difficult sites. Needs a key or your own server.

web.providers.firecrawl-api-key.label: Firecrawl key
web.providers.firecrawl-api-key.help: From firecrawl.dev. Kept in your server's keychain.

web.providers.firecrawl-url.label: Firecrawl address
web.providers.firecrawl-url.help: Use your own Firecrawl server instead of the cloud one.

web.providers.exa-enable.label: Exa
web.providers.exa-enable.help: Strong at search and deep research. Needs a key.

web.providers.tavily-enable.label: Tavily
web.providers.tavily-enable.help: Searches, reads and extracts pages. Needs a key.

web.providers.tavily-fetch-mode.label: How deeply Tavily reads
web.providers.tavily-fetch-mode.help: Deeper reading costs more per page.

web.providers.brave-enable.label: Brave Search
web.providers.brave-enable.help: An independent search index. Needs a key.

web.providers.jina-enable.label: Jina Reader
web.providers.jina-enable.help: Reads pages other services can't. Needs a key.

web.providers.model-native-enable.label: Your AI model's own web search
web.providers.model-native-enable.help: Uses your model account, no extra key. Tried last.

web.providers.capability-matrix.label: Which service does each job
web.providers.capability-matrix.help: The first choice and the backups for each ability.

options.model-native: Your AI model's own web search

web.providers.web-api-keys.label: Service keys
web.providers.web-api-keys.help: Add, replace or remove a web service's key.

web.fetch.pdf-mode.label: How PDFs are read
web.fetch.pdf-mode.help: Scanned PDFs need the slower reader.

web.fetch.search-max-results.label: Results per search
web.fetch.search-max-results.help: More results give broader answers but cost more.

web.fetch.research-auto-read-pages.label: Pages read before asking you
web.fetch.research-auto-read-pages.help: Research asks before opening more than this.

web.fetch.crawl-max-depth.label: How many links deep a crawl goes

web.fetch.map-max-pages.label: Most pages in a site outline

web.fetch.map-max-depth.label: How many links deep an outline goes

web.fetch.request-timeout.label: Time limit per page
web.fetch.request-timeout.help: Seconds to wait for one page before giving up.

web.fetch.cost-warning-threshold.label: Ask before spending more than
web.fetch.cost-warning-threshold.help: In credits. Bigger web jobs wait for your OK.

web.fetch.cost-hard-cap.label: Never spend more than
web.fetch.cost-hard-cap.help: In credits. Bigger jobs stop unless you approve that one.

web.fetch.provider-cache.label: Let Firecrawl reuse its saved copies

web.fetch.cache-size.label: Space for saved web pages
web.fetch.cache-size.help: The oldest pages are dropped when it's full.

web.fetch.cache-ttl-search.label: Keep search results for
web.fetch.cache-ttl-search.help: After this they are fetched again.

web.fetch.redirect-policy.label: Let your own servers redirect
web.fetch.redirect-policy.help: Where a self-hosted service may pass a request on to.

web.fetch.egress-timeout.label: Time limit for your own servers
web.fetch.egress-timeout.help: Seconds before a slow self-hosted service is cut off.

web.fetch.proxy-mode.label: Proxy
web.fetch.proxy-mode.help: Most people use this computer's settings.

web.fetch.proxy-credentials.label: Proxy sign-in
web.fetch.proxy-credentials.help: Only if your proxy asks for a name and password.

web.fetch.ca-bundle.label: Company certificate file
web.fetch.ca-bundle.help: For networks that inspect secure traffic.

web.fetch.per-host-ca.label: Certificates for specific sites
web.fetch.per-host-ca.help: Use a certificate only for the sites you list.

web.fetch.air-gap-mode.label: Work offline
web.fetch.air-gap-mode.help: Blocks all internet use. Saved pages still work.
